notes.title: Post your dishes to the in-game social media!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=i7XFfF75ORw;full][/previewyoutube]
We are thrilled to announce that “Debut Project: Cooking Café” is now available for purchase on Steam!! Purchase during the first 7 days of launch to receive 10% off!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269430/421989aa63277512ba504860987d93448ce1d3e5.jpg
Post your dishes to the in-game social media!
Check out the comments from your followers and see how many “Likes” your dishes get!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269430/ee48d2caea854c6e40822500009064e4ff3d2cb7.jpg
The more “Likes” you get, the higher your “Flavor Rank” will be, allowing you to try new dishes!

As you continue to cook the same dish, its “Mastery Level” will increase, unlocking new menus and toppings of the dish for even more variety.

You can also participate in “Hashtag Challenges” by creating dishes that match the given hashtags, or even create your own original menu!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3155560/

notes.title: “Debut Project: Cooking Café” AVAILABLE NOW!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=i7XFfF75ORw;full][/previewyoutube]
We are thrilled to announce that “Debut Project: Cooking Café” is now available for purchase on Steam!! Purchase during the first 7 days of launch to receive 10% off!

Players will take on the role of a new café employee, taking orders from customers, completing missions, and creating visually appealing dishes perfect for social media.

It's a cooking game where you post the dishes you've made on the in-game social media, aiming for a million followers by getting "Likes" and improving your store's rating.

80 different dishes you can make!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33518623/68b57e8ae3059094f48d2a28aa3294eed61e68d5.jpg

You can experience making dishes like pancakes, crepes, hamburg steak, cakes, and Omurice through 13 different minigames.

Enjoy creating stylish and photogenic dishes by swirling soft serve ice cream onto a cone, drawing pictures on pancakes with sauce, and customizing your creations with 271 different toppings.

There are 80 dishes in total that you can make! Let's try making various kinds of dishes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3155560/

notes.title: A success story of a rookie café worker!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=i7XFfF75ORw;full][/previewyoutube]
“Debut Project: Cooking Café” will be available on November 14th on Steam! Purchase during the first 7 days of launch to receive 10% off!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269430/d37951c517a11bebee637611de8dd2b620f70ce9.jpg

A success story of a rookie café worker!
You work as a new server in a café and take orders from customers on a daily basis.

You create dishes that look good on social media and posts them. Increase the “likes” and “rating” of your café, and make very famous with 1 million followers!

As your café becomes more famous, popular influencers will visit your café and your fan base will grow. Experience a success story where you become famous along with your café!

You can choose your own hairstyle and costume in the character makeover as you like.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269430/7ce53b8858ed95a5e9774c54e78b691232148ffc.jpg

If the number of “followers” increases...
When the number of “followers” reaches a certain level, your café expands greatly!

The café starts out small, but as more floors are added, it evolves into a more luxurious interior. Do your best to get as many “followers” as possible!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3155560/
